question: Who transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs described as good eaters?
premises: The recipients are the earth-moving yoginīs.
They are described as good eaters.
inference: An earth-mover transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs who are good eaters.
uncertainties: The form bhūcarī is taken as instrumental singular but could be ambiguous.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters, by an earth-mover.
